Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 14  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concludes that Takhir Sabirov, the director of "The Last Night of Scheherazade," was born earlier than Jean Yarbrough. In reality, the information gathered shows Jean Yarbrough was born in 1900, while Takhir Sabirov was born in 1929, indicating that Jean Yarbrough was born earlier. The Planner misinterpreted the data, leading to the wrong conclusion.
